Test key, written by the same call as flop_did.py. It is named .pem.txt so that the rule
hiding every .pem never hides it, from the seed 00 01 02 ... 1f.
Its passphrase is public: correct horse battery staple. It protects nothing and is never
used anywhere. It exists so the tests can prove that opening an identity.pem in the browser
derives the DID the Python tool prints for the same key.
